verdict.rationale: FreshBooks provides the building blocks for a custom monitoring agent. Its OAuth-scoped REST API exposes expenses, payments, journal entries and reports, and signed webhooks deliver real-time event notifications, though delivery timing is not guaranteed. The pack shows no native anomaly or duplicate-transaction detection, so the user would have to build the flagging logic themselves. Missing for 10: native spend-anomaly or duplicate detection, any first-party agent or MCP integration (llms.txt and docs-md both return 404), close-workflow tooling, and hands-on corroboration that such monitoring works.
